strong_proposal.title: AI-Based Cloudburst Early Warning System for KPK
strong_proposal.problem_statement: KPK faces devastating cloudburst events annually with no AI-based early warning system. PMD ground stations are absent in high-risk mountainous districts.
strong_proposal.technical_description: ConvLSTM model trained on NASA GPM-IMERG satellite data and ERA5 atmospheric variables. FastAPI backend. React dashboard. Deployed on AWS.
strong_proposal.technology_stack: Python, TensorFlow, FastAPI, React, PostgreSQL, AWS

weak_proposal.technical_description: We will make a chatbot using Python.

ethics_flagged_proposal.title: AI-Based Facial Recognition Attendance System for Universities
ethics_flagged_proposal.problem_statement: Manual attendance is time-consuming. We propose using facial recognition cameras in classrooms to automatically mark attendance.
ethics_flagged_proposal.technical_description: DeepFace library with custom fine-tuning on student photos. Cameras installed in all classrooms. Central database stores facial embeddings. Real-time attendance marking.
ethics_flagged_proposal.technology_stack: Python, DeepFace, OpenCV, PostgreSQL, FastAPI, React
